title: Remove an item without mutating
why_it_matters: This is the standard way to delete from React state.
explanation: To delete an item from a list, use filter to keep everything except that one. You get a new array while the old one stays intact. React notices the new array and updates the screen, which wouldn't happen if you edited the original.
try_it: Write removeById(list, id) that returns a new array and never edits the old one.
